defects.evidence: L195: "every command assigned to P1 in section 3 except `load` has a `## Unattended mode` section" - AC-1.1 and P1 scope now cover the same set; later-phase and P4 commands are not asserted in P1.

L73: "`--unattended` once the command's phase has delivered it (P0 briefs omit it)" - Flag and section are delivered per phase with the gates; 2.3 passes --unattended only once the phase delivered it.

L196: "7.2 live check on each P1 command with `--unattended` and the output flag WC-4 names for it" - load is excluded from the section and AC-1.1, but AC-1.2 still runs the live check on each P1 command and load is in the P1 Commands cell with no contract.
L79: "(P1 for brainstorm and init-lite, otherwise the phase of the small fix)" - brainstorm and init-lite are assigned to P1 in 3.1 text, in the P1 Commands cell and in AC-1.1.

L79: "otherwise the phase of the small fix" - 3.1 commands get their section in the phase of their fix (P2 for tdd/troubleshoot/release-split/reflect); line 79 still says Phase 1 adds the contract, a minor stale wording.

L62: "Where `--output` names a file (tdd, init-lite), `<output-dir>` is that file's parent directory, which the brief dedicates to this Task." - WC-4 now states the contract location for a file-valued --output (parent directory dedicated to the Task) and spec-panel uses --report-dir; ambiguous because the dedicated-directory rule is only in WC-4.

L62: "A row in section 3 may name another fixed path, which then is the WC-4 path (adversarial: `<output>/adversarial/return-contract.yaml`)" - WC-4 names the adversarial subpath as a named exception that becomes the WC-4 path.

L62: "a workflow STOP before its package directory exists), the command writes no file" - Run-time path is now read from the final output and passed as --report-path, but a pre-creation STOP now writes no contract at all (obligation removed, deletion_ok false).

L85: "Name the `--pass all` final report; output dir is fixed, so one audit per worktree at a time (WC-11) (P1)" - troubleshoot is covered by the run-time-name rule, but cleanup-audit and index-repo still have no directory flag or stated contract path, and AC-1.2 uses the 'output flag WC-4 names for it'.

L104: "contract for both pipelines (today a chat table)" - research/workflow get the run-time path rule, but cli-eval, cli-portify, recommend, task, save, review-translation and implement rows are unchanged with no flag or location, and the new no-directory-flag clause contradicts AC-2.2's cli-eval example.

L194: "in step 3 the report path is the command's existing report file and `--outcome` matches the status that file states" - AC-0.4 now gives a P0 form of step 3 (existing report file, status that file states).
L194: "step 4 is `test -s <that file>` only, since the contract arrives in P1" - Step 4 for P0 is reduced to test -s on the existing file.
L73: "(P0 briefs omit it)" - 2.3 requires --unattended only from the phase that delivers it and P0 briefs omit it, matching AC-0.4.

L194: "each run directly by the worker (no Agent-tool wrapper, verified in the step-5 transcript)" - AC-0.4 still relies on the step-5 transcript for 'no Agent-tool wrapper', while step 5 only searches AskUserQuestion.
L182: "--timeout-ms 900000 --json` until `worker_done` arrives" - Step 3 is still a single 900000 ms blocking wait while step 2 needs worker-show every 5 minutes; no concurrency stated.
L181: "`observation.agentWait` is present and null in every reply" - Step 2 now requires agentWait present and null in every reply; absence is not a pass.
L185: "`git status --short`. **Pass:** only files under the brief's output directory" - Step 6 still has no pre-dispatch baseline.
L185: "(and the command's documented artifacts) appear" - Step 6 still does not define what edit-in-place commands may change; 'documented artifacts' undefined.
L184: "search the transcript for `AskUserQuestion`" - Step 5 is still a plain-text search for AskUserQuestion.
L176: "grep -E '^-[^-]'` | prints nothing: edits are additive" - AC-C5 still greps '^-[^-]', missing removed bullets and '---' lines.
L193: "grep -E '^-[^-]'` | prints nothing: no existing routing row changed (SA-5)" - AC-C1 is rewritten as a single raw-copyable grep, but AC-C4, AC-C5 and AC-0.3 still use table-escaped '\|' pipes.
L172: "`core/` is not scanned: P0 adds an Orca section to `HOW-WE-WORK.md` there and SA-2 lets the contract file mention Orca" - AC-C1 no longer scans core/ and says why, matching SA-2's scope.
L147: "No command, skill or agent file runs an `orca` or `orca-ide` command" - AC-C1 still matches only orchestration, worktree, terminal and agent while SA-2 bans any orca/orca-ide command.

L61: "the brief's gate path is `ask` (section 2.3), the session asks the coordinator once" - The ask path is now opt-in (default ends blocked), but nothing says an ask reply is never used as the implement Ruling or another person-only approval.

L61: "waits, then re-invokes or resumes the command with the answer as a flag into the same output directory" - WC-3 still re-invokes the command with the coordinator's answer as a flag, and no rule says an answer never supplies a WC-9 outward flag.

L61: "With any other brief the run ends blocked (WC-2 (c))" - The brief now selects the gate path (default end blocked) and AC-2.2 uses the default path, so the expected outcome is deterministic; ambiguous because 7.2 still has no question/escalation handling and AC-4.1 does not name the gate path.
L201: "except cli-portify and review-translation, whose gates only block" - cli-portify row says no caller input passes a gate, so it ends blocked, and AC-2.3 exempts it.

L200: "Gate-trigger run per P2 command: a 7.2 live check with a brief whose gate path is the default" - AC-2.2 still demands failed/blocked from every P2 command although auggie-review, cleanup, improve, research, reflect and tasklist resolve gates by default or flag.

L63: "or the file is empty, unparseable or has a `status` outside the four values" - WC-5 now maps missing, empty, unparseable or out-of-vocabulary status to failed and succeeded only for succeeded/partial.

L63: "`--outcome failed` when the report says `failed` or `blocked`, no report exists" - WC-5 still gives no per-command way to read the outcome from interim non-contract reports (REPORT.md, TDD); only AC-0.4 has a P0 form, and the new 'unparseable' clause makes markdown reports ambiguous.

L73: "that cleanup-audit and index-repo are not run in parallel in one worktree (WC-11)" - 2.3 and WC-11 now state a coordinator obligation not to run cleanup-audit and index-repo in parallel in one worktree, but no check covers it.
L87: "Fresh dir per retry (a re-run overwrites its marked report, `INV-A:55`)" - init-lite row now gives a fresh directory per retry.
L64: "is given a fresh output directory in each retry's brief (section 2.3)" - WC-6 and 2.3 now say the brief gives a fresh output directory on every retry.
L69: "Default output paths carry a timestamp or the slug the coordinator passes" - WC-11's default-path clause and WC-10 still have no unattended scope, against SA-1.
L111: "state that knowledge-base mode does not wait (whether it does is UNVERIFIED)" - Index row still only asserts knowledge-base mode does not wait.
L91: "| troubleshoot | no `--fix` |" - tdd and troubleshoot brief constraints are unchanged; troubleshoot only forbids --fix.
L182: "`ORCA orchestration check --wait --types" - 7.2 ORCA commands still carry no --from/--terminal.
L209: "with no authorization flags" - AC-4.2 still has no explicit pre-tag choice.
L209: "the contract lists each skipped outward step" - No field for skipped outward steps is defined in WC-4 or the post-release row.
L209: "`git log -1` unchanged and no new PR" - AC-4.2 still only observes git log and the PR list.

L148: "A standalone default run writes the same files it writes today." - SA-4 dropped the workflow fix (workflow no longer writes a standalone contract), but the adversarial filename fix is still ungated and SA-3 names no exception.
L16: "What changes in the commands is limited to the worker contract in section 2" - Section 1.1 still says command changes are limited to the worker contract.
L105: "dispatch only inside an IronClaude checkout (hardcoded template path)" - cli-portify checkout restriction is still not in SA-4 or marked a coordinator rule.
L210: "no single tool call exceeds 240 s" - WC-10 trigger (5 min) and AC-4.3 limit (240 s) still differ.

L62: "the command writes no file, prints the blocked question or STOP in chat and stops" - WC-4 says with no directory flag the command writes no file and the worker reports failed with no report path, while cli-eval, recommend, task, save etc. get no flag and AC-2.2 expects a blocked contract for cli-eval without --suite.
